title: Enhancing the strength and plasticity of laser powder bed fused NbMoTaW refractory high-entropy alloy via Ti alloying
process_description: prepared by laser powder bed fusion using a 200W fiber laser with parameters: laser power 200W, scanning speed 400mm/s, layer thickness 30μm, hatch spacing 0.10mm, laser focus diameter 60μm, in high purity argon environment (O < 300ppm)
